name: Safe{Wallet} multisig: signers, threshold, simulate & execute
goal: Create a Safe smart-account multisig on a supported chain, add signers, set signature threshold, fund via Receive, then propose a Send with simulation and collect multi-signer confirmations before execute — with each signer on a separate seed/hardware key.

source.title: Safe{Wallet}: How to Securely Set Up and Use Your Safe MultiSig Wallet

prerequisites: Second signer on a separate seed/device
constraints: Educational self-custody/tax procedure only — not financial advice; no coin tips or return promises.
Ground every step in YouTube-provided captions; portable UI names OK when vendor chrome drifts.
Never digitize a seed phrase or enter it into a website/phone camera.
Do not put all signers on one browser seed — that defeats multisig.
Prefer hardware signers for meaningful balances.

steps.action: Safe homepage → Launch Wallet; select chain (many mainnets + testnets).
Get Started → continue with connected wallet; name Safe; confirm chain; Next.
Add owner addresses; set threshold (e.g. 2-of-2). Review → Create (pay deploy fee).
Dashboard → Receive → copy Safe address → fund from a separate wallet.
Send → Send tokens: destination + amount. Run transaction check / Tenderly simulation especially for contract interactions.
Signer 1 signs (queue shows e.g. 1/2). Switch to signer 2 connected to Safe → Confirm → Execute. Verify History.
